# Data Generation

We first consider a case with a fully discrete setting

```{r}
datagen_discrete_iv_singleZ <- function(
  n = 2000,
  z_levels = 2,
  x_levels = 2,
  y_levels = 2,
  b_zx = 0.8,            
  b_ux = 0.3,
  b_uy = 0.3,
  b_uz = 0,
  b_zy = 0,            
  x_intercept = 0,
  y_intercept = 0,
  shape = c("linear", "nonlinear_monotone", "non_monotone"),
  x_cuts = NULL,
  y_cuts = NULL
) {
  shape <- match.arg(shape)

  make_cuts <- function(k) {
    if (k == 2) 0 else qnorm(seq(1 / k, (k - 1) / k, length.out = k - 1))
  }

  if (is.null(x_cuts)) x_cuts <- make_cuts(x_levels)
  if (is.null(y_cuts)) y_cuts <- make_cuts(y_levels)

  U <- rnorm(n)

  if (b_uz == 0) {
    Z <- sample(seq_len(z_levels), n, replace = TRUE)
  } else {
    Z_star <- b_uz * U + rnorm(n)
    z_cuts <- qnorm(seq(1 / z_levels, (z_levels - 1) / z_levels, length.out = z_levels - 1))
    Z <- findInterval(Z_star, z_cuts) + 1
  }

  # Deterministic centering instead of scale() to preserve I.I.D.
  Z_centered <- Z - mean(seq_len(z_levels))

  f_x <- function(val) {
    if (shape == "linear") {
      0.6 * val
    } else if (shape == "nonlinear_monotone") {
      0.25 * val^2
    } else {
      # Fixed to ensure it actually has an effect even if x_levels == 2
      if (x_levels == 2) {
        ifelse(val == 1, 0, 1) # Force an effect
      } else {
        mid <- (x_levels + 1) / 2
        -0.5 * (val - mid)^2
      }
    }
  }

  # Reduced noise: multiplied rlogis by 0.5 to strengthen the IV bounds testing
  X_star <- x_intercept + b_zx * Z_centered + b_ux * U + 0.5 * rlogis(n)
  X <- as.integer(findInterval(X_star, x_cuts) + 1)

  Y_star <- y_intercept + f_x(X) + b_uy * U + b_zy * Z_centered + 0.5 * rlogis(n)
  Y <- as.integer(findInterval(Y_star, y_cuts) + 1)

  data.frame(
    Z = Z,
    U = U,
    X = X,
    Y = Y
  )
}
```

# Instrumental inequalities

```{r}
run_instrumental_inequalities_singlejointiv <- function(data, y, x, instrument) {

  dat <- data.frame(
    Y  = factor(data[[y]]),
    X  = factor(data[[x]]),
    IV = factor(data[[instrument]])
  )

  cnt_xyz <- xtabs(~ IV + X + Y, data = dat)
  cnt_z   <- xtabs(~ IV, data = dat)

  p_xyz <- sweep(cnt_xyz, 1, cnt_z, "/")
  p_xyz[!is.finite(p_xyz)] <- NA_real_

  x_levels <- dimnames(p_xyz)$X
  y_levels <- dimnames(p_xyz)$Y

res <- lapply(seq_along(x_levels), function(ix) {

    mat <- p_xyz[, ix, ]   # Z × Y

    # Safely calculate max, returning 0 if all are NA to prevent -Inf
    max_per_y <- apply(mat, 2, function(col) {
      if (all(is.na(col))) 0 else max(col, na.rm = TRUE)
    })

    ineq_val <- sum(max_per_y, na.rm = TRUE)

    data.frame(
      X = x_levels[ix],
      inequality_value = ineq_val,
      violated = ineq_val > (1 + 1e-8) # Floating-point tolerance
    )
  })

  res <- do.call(rbind, res)

  list(
    inequalities = res,
    max_value = max(res$inequality_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    violated = any(res$violated, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

# Generating Data

```{r}
settings <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    id = 1:9,
    z_levels = 2:10,
    x_levels = 2:10,
    y_levels = 2:10
  ),
  data.frame(
    id = 10,
    z_levels = 10,
    x_levels = 10,
    y_levels = 2
  )
)

shapes <- c(
  "linear",
  "nonlinear_monotone",
  "non_monotone"
)

datasets <- list()

for (s in shapes) {

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(settings))) {

    zlev <- settings$z_levels[i]
    xlev <- settings$x_levels[i]
    ylev <- settings$y_levels[i]

    # -----------------------
    # Valid IV dataset
    # -----------------------

    key_valid <- paste0(
      s,
      "_Z", zlev,
      "_X", xlev,
      "_Y", ylev,
      "_valid"
    )

    datasets[[key_valid]] <- datagen_discrete_iv_singleZ(
      n = 100000,
      z_levels = zlev,
      x_levels = xlev,
      y_levels = ylev,
      shape = s,
      b_zy = 0
    )

    # -----------------------
    # Invalid IV dataset
    # -----------------------

    key_invalid <- paste0(
      s,
      "_Z", zlev,
      "_X", xlev,
      "_Y", ylev,
      "_invalid"
    )

    datasets[[key_invalid]] <- datagen_discrete_iv_singleZ(
      n = 100000,
      z_levels = zlev,
      x_levels = xlev,
      y_levels = ylev,
      shape = s,
      b_zy = 2
    )
  }
}
```

# Checking Inequalities results

```{r}
results <- list()
summary_list <- list()

for (nm in names(datasets[19])) {

  dat <- datasets[[nm]]

  ineq <- run_instrumental_inequalities_singlejointiv(
    data = dat,
    y = "Y",
    x = "X",
    instrument = "Z"
  )

  results[[nm]] <- list(
    ineq = ineq,
    max_value = ineq$max_value,
    violated = ineq$violated
  )

  summary_list[[length(summary_list)+1]] <- data.frame(
    dataset = nm,
    max_value = ineq$max_value,
    violated = ineq$violated
  )
}

summary_tbl <- do.call(rbind, summary_list)
summary_tbl
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 1. Define your common parameters here ----------------------------------------
# Replace placeholders with your actual column names and settings
TARGET_OUTCOME   <- "Y"
TARGET_TREATMENT <- "X"
TARGET_GROUP     <- "Z"

# Optional parameters (set to NULL if you want the function to auto-detect)
ASSUMPTIONS      <-  NULL # e.g., c("MTR") if supported by your setup
K_VAL            <- NULL  
M_VAL            <- NULL  

# 2. Prepare the loop ---------------------------------------------------------
# Ensure your list of datasets has names for easier tracking
if (is.null(names(datasets))) {
  names(datasets) <- paste0("dataset_", seq_along(datasets))
}

all_bounds_results <- list()

# 3. Iterate over the datasets ------------------------------------------------
for (ds_name in names(datasets[19])) {
  
  cat("\n##################################################\n")
  cat("STARTING PROCESSING FOR:", ds_name, "\n")
  cat("##################################################\n")
  
  # Safeguard the loop with tryCatch
  res <- tryCatch({
    
    # Execute your custom function
    df_bounds <- compute_ace_bounds(
      data        = datasets[[ds_name]],
      outcome     = TARGET_OUTCOME,
      treatment   = TARGET_TREATMENT,
      group       = TARGET_GROUP,
      assumptions = ASSUMPTIONS,
      k           = K_VAL,
      m           = M_VAL,
      verbose     = TRUE,
      slack_val = 0.005,
      tolerance = 0.0001
    )
    
    # Append the dataset name so you know where the bounds came from
    if (!is.null(df_bounds) && nrow(df_bounds) > 0) {
      df_bounds <- df_bounds %>% dplyr::mutate(dataset_id = ds_name)
    }
    
    df_bounds
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("⚠️ Error encountered in dataset '", ds_name, "': ", e$message)
    return(NULL)  # Return NULL on failure to keep the loop moving
  })
  
  # Store the result if successful
  all_bounds_results[[ds_name]] <- res
}

# 4. Consolidate results into a master Data Frame ----------------------------
final_bounds_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_bounds_results)

cat("\n==================================================\n")
cat("ALL DATASETS PROCESSED\n")
cat("==================================================\n")
print(final_bounds_summary)
```

# True ACE estimation

```{r}
fx_fun <- function(x, shape, x_levels) {

  if(shape == "linear") {
    0.6 * x

  } else if(shape == "nonlinear_monotone") {
    0.25 * x^2

  } else {

    if(x_levels == 2) {
      ifelse(x == 1, 0, 1)
    } else {
      mid <- (x_levels + 1) / 2
      -0.5 * (x - mid)^2
    }
  }
}


true_do_prob <- function(dat,
                         x,
                         y_level,
                         shape,
                         x_levels,
                         y_levels,
                         b_uy = 0.3,
                         b_zy = 0,
                         y_intercept = 0) {

  y_cuts <- if(y_levels == 2) {
    0
  } else {
    qnorm(seq(1/y_levels,
              (y_levels-1)/y_levels,
              length.out = y_levels-1))
  }

  z_centered <- dat$Z - mean(seq_len(max(dat$Z)))

  mu <- y_intercept +
    fx_fun(x, shape, x_levels) +
    b_uy * dat$U +
    b_zy * z_centered

  scale_eps <- 0.5

  if(y_level == 1) {

    p <- plogis((y_cuts[1] - mu)/scale_eps)

  } else if(y_level == y_levels) {

    p <- 1 - plogis((y_cuts[y_levels-1] - mu)/scale_eps)

  } else {

    upper <- plogis((y_cuts[y_level] - mu)/scale_eps)
    lower <- plogis((y_cuts[y_level-1] - mu)/scale_eps)

    p <- upper - lower
  }

  mean(p)
}



true_mean_ace <- function(dat,
                          shape,
                          x_levels,
                          y_levels,
                          b_uy = 0.3,
                          b_zy = 0,
                          y_intercept = 0) {

  x0 <- 1
  x1 <- x_levels

  y_vals <- seq_len(y_levels)

  p_x1 <- sapply(y_vals, function(y) {
    true_do_prob(
      dat = dat,
      x = x1,
      y_level = y,
      shape = shape,
      x_levels = x_levels,
      y_levels = y_levels,
      b_uy = b_uy,
      b_zy = b_zy,
      y_intercept = y_intercept
    )
  })

  p_x0 <- sapply(y_vals, function(y) {
    true_do_prob(
      dat = dat,
      x = x0,
      y_level = y,
      shape = shape,
      x_levels = x_levels,
      y_levels = y_levels,
      b_uy = b_uy,
      b_zy = b_zy,
      y_intercept = y_intercept
    )
  })

  EY_x1 <- sum(y_vals * p_x1)
  EY_x0 <- sum(y_vals * p_x0)

  data.frame(
    x1 = x1,
    x0 = x0,
    EY_do_x1 = EY_x1,
    EY_do_x0 = EY_x0,
    ace = EY_x1 - EY_x0
  )
}
true_aces <- lapply(names(datasets), function(nm) {

  shape <- sub("_Z.*", "", nm)

  x_levels <- as.integer(
    sub(".*_X([0-9]+)_Y.*", "\\1", nm)
  )

  y_levels <- as.integer(
    sub(".*_Y([0-9]+)_.*", "\\1", nm)
  )

  out <- true_mean_ace(
    dat = datasets[[nm]],
    shape = shape,
    x_levels = x_levels,
    y_levels = y_levels
  )

  out$dataset <- nm

  out
})

true_aces <- do.call(rbind, true_aces)

row.names(true_aces) <- NULL
```
